title: Quantum Computing
description: From logic and reversible computation to quantum states, interference, circuits, and algorithms. Develop the mathematical foundations and explore them through interactive experiments.
prerequisite: Basic linear algebra. No prior quantum mechanics required.

title: Quantum Algorithms
description: Develop quantum algorithms through coherent computation, phase encoding, Fourier methods, amplitude manipulation, walks, and operator transformations.
details: 11 developed chapters · Worked examples and solved problems · By Mithilesh Kumar
prerequisite: Quantum Computing course or equivalent knowledge.

title: Quantum Programming
description: Turn quantum algorithms into correct, testable, and reproducible programs with Qiskit. Explore language design, circuit construction, simulation, compilation, and hardware execution.
details: 16 developed chapters · Worked examples and solved problems · By Mithilesh Kumar
prerequisite: Quantum Computing and Quantum Algorithms, or equivalent knowledge. Python essentials are introduced in the course.

title: Quantum Information
description: From distinguishable messages and classical information to quantum states, entanglement, compression, error correction, communication, and cryptography. Develop the necessary mathematics through concrete information-processing tasks.
details: 16 developed chapters · Worked examples and solved problems · By Mithilesh Kumar
prerequisite: No prior quantum mechanics, information theory, or linear algebra course required. Mathematics is developed in context.

title: Quantum Hardware
description: From physical qubits, control, coupling, and readout to hardware platforms, bosonic and topological encodings, processor architecture, and fault-tolerant implementation.
details: 19 developed chapters · Worked examples and solved problems · By Mithilesh Kumar
prerequisite: Quantum Computing course or equivalent knowledge. Device physics is introduced in context.
